name: Web
author: E. T. Carter
description: A dew-strung orb web seen close and at an angle, the way a macro lens catches it at dawn: faceted capture passes wind out from a single off-centre hub, but the silk is barely there - every thread is a dense string of dew pearls, and a shallow depth of field holds one band in sharp focus while the rest melts into soft glowing bokeh. The foreshortened sheet sags under gravity and the pearls glint awake in a slow chase out from the hub.

params.label: Spokes
params.effect: Number of radial silk spokes the capture thread is strung between; low gives a coarse web, high a fine many-sided one.

params.label: Capture spacing
params.effect: Radial gap between passes of the capture thread in CSS px; tight spacing crowds the web with fine dewy threads, wide gives sweeping passes.

params.label: Pearl density
params.effect: How closely dew pearls are strung along each thread; low gives fat spaced droplets, high a fine close-strung string of beads.

params.label: Facet
params.effect: Shape of the capture thread between spokes: 0 smooth round rings, 1 straight chords bowing inward into an angular web.

params.label: Spiral wind
params.effect: How much the capture thread winds outward as a continuous spiral rather than closing into separate rings.

params.label: Gravity sag
params.effect: How far the hung web droops under its own weight; 0 a flat true wheel, high sags the lower web into heavy teardrop passes.

params.label: Perspective
params.effect: Foreshortening of the web sheet; 0 is a flat front-on view, high tilts it away so it recedes across the frame like a macro shot.

params.label: Depth of field
params.effect: Shallowness of focus; 0 keeps the whole web crisp, high blooms the out-of-focus dew into big soft bokeh discs.

params.label: Focal band
params.effect: Where the sharp in-focus band sits up or down the frame; the dew is crisp here and blurs away from it.

params.label: Backlight
params.effect: A soft bespoke backlight glow behind the web, cool with a warm bloom; 0 is pure void, high a dawn-lit haze.

params.label: Glint speed
params.effect: Rate at which the dew pearls light up in a chase spiralling out from the hub, from a slow drift to a lively sparkle.
